claim_one_line: THE OBJECT IS A FIXED POINT OF MORE THAN xB021 COULD SEE, AND THE INVARIANTS SPLIT INTO EXACTLY TWO SPECIES RATHER THAN FOUR. PREREGISTRATION sealed f153f67dcb0a27e8 and PUSHED at cbfeec0 before verification/ existed, with the predicted stabiliser table written in advance. V0: the 494-word corpus REBUILT from xB015 K6's rule (checked against the closed form sum(2^n - 2) = 494), and on it both banked laws reproduce -- A5 shifts CS by 1/4 494/494, A7 negates CS 494/494. V1: vol(b++w) = vol(b+-w) at 1e-25 for 494 of 494, with a positive control proving the comparator can see a difference, so A5 IS IN VOLUME'S STABILISER. V2: the mirror and the letter swap each preserve volume 240/240 and H_1 240/240 -- RUN, not asserted, because an assertion beside a number that does not test it is E69. V3: H_1(b++w) != H_1(b+-w) for 494 of 494, 100 percent, STRONGER than the seal's predicted majority; H_1 behaves like CS, not like volume. V4: no Sage on this bench, so the field instrument was BUILT here on PARI algdep under a guard (detect at 30 digits, then require irreducibility and vanishing at 60); m004 and m003 both give x^2 - x + 1 = Q(sqrt-3), 40/40 sampled pairs agree, control m015 gives x^3 - x - 1; GRADED as the SHAPE FIELD, its identification with the invariant trace field NOT claimed and Neumann-Reid NOT cited (E58). V5: all four sealed predictions confirmed. V6, THE BINDING KILL CONDITION, WHICH DID NOT FIRE: each of xB021's three unexplained arithmetic negatives turns on an invariant whose orbit is TRIVIAL, so they were never stabiliser negatives -- they are a THIRD SPECIES, questions asked of an invariant with NO ORBIT, which is why xB021's 'move to the orbit' cannot reach them even in principle. V7: |Tor H_1| is NOT surjective onto Z/12 (9 of 12 residues) so H_1 shares CS's stabiliser but NOT CS's family index, reported as the null it is, with every modulus printed rather than the first hit because a hit at m = 2 is trivial and would itself be E69. EXPLORATORY AND LABELLED: |Tor H_1(b+-w)| - |Tor H_1(b++w)| = 4 EXACTLY for all 494 words -- A5 shifts CS by 1/4 and torsion order by +4 -- together with the caution measured in the same cell, that (b++ square, b+- not) occurs 70 times against 80 for the reverse, so square torsion does NOT pick the b++ branch in general and that limit is carried into xB023 rather than left for a reader to find. Supplies no value; xB016's closure is untouched. Axes held fixed and named. Gate 5 absolute; nothing to CLAIMS.md.

This arc analyses all three and finds the picture SIMPLER than xB021's framing implied: the invariants split into TWO species, not four. xB021's stabiliser {A6, A7} for CS is confirmed and is now shown to be shared by H_1; volume and the shape field have a TRIVIAL orbit. xB021's 'move to the orbit' remedy is SCOPED: it cannot reach an invariant with no orbit, which is precisely why its three misses did not fit.
